'''Red Smoke''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of ten veteran [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]] that were part of the force [[Mission to Goratak III|dispatched]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goratak III]] to recover an [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that had ejected from a [[Tech 4 PDV]]. Each soldier carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], and included two [[Specialist/Legends|specialists]]; one carrying a [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]], and the other armed with four [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].
